_note: Approximate PUBLIC centroids of major international oil/gas flaring regions, used to group real flare detections by field/basin. Coordinates are approximate public locations; the analysis snaps REAL flare detections (from the World Bank / VIIRS individual-flare-location dataset) to the nearest field within its radius. No claim is made here about any operator. Verdicts must be worded as consistency between observations and a stated public commitment.
claim_source: Public flaring commitments come from the World Bank 'Zero Routine Flaring by 2030' (ZRF) initiative: https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/gasflaringreduction/zero-routine-flaring-by-2030 . Use the official endorser list for who has committed; do not assume membership.
